answer: Make each new identity post a deposit that unlocks only after months of good work, then flag accounts whose answers land within seconds of each other with near-identical wording. Like a falcon spotting one moving shape among still yarrow, the detector picks out a herd that acts in lockstep. When a cluster is caught, every linked deposit is slashed at once, so running a hundred fake names costs a hundred forfeits, which is a price as hard as onyx for one operator.
